findings.detail: Corrected zero/one-exchange statement: zero exchanges retain all plain assistant messages; one exchange drops prior plain messages and retains from that exchange onward.

verified_behavior: Reuses frozen complete-exchange projector; entire executed input is validated before old groups are omitted.
Retains newest two complete exchanges and subsequent plain assistant messages, with exact retained reasoning/tool fields and complete tool outputs; no input mutation.
Incomplete/orphan/duplicate/malformed exchanges fail before pruning; multi-tool reply order may vary when pairing remains complete.
No protected/pending/archive injections, synthetic summary, argument repair or token-count claim. Oversized retained content remains intact.
limitations: Structural two-exchange bound only; native measured input/output admission remains required.
Only executed assistant/tool history belongs in this adapter; episode separately assembles public task/system/tools/final packet and preserves original capture/receipt evidence.
Complete baseline episode, common comparison semantics, independent-arm history policy, finalization reserve, real tokenizer qualification and campaign freeze remain pending.
